BiblicalUsage: Kanan is a word Strong's lists for setting out or planting, but it never actually occurs in the Hebrew text — no verse uses it, and no form of the root stands anywhere in the Scriptures.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that honesty matters more than filling a gap: where the text is silent, I say so, and I will not invent a verse for a word God never used.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
